pack.name: Reliability and Resilience
pack.description: Provider-neutral reliability and resilience screening for architecture reviews — failure modes, recovery objectives, redundancy proportional to criticality, backup, and graceful degradation. Thematic mapping only; not a certification.

rules.title: Failure modes identified for critical dependencies
rules.description: Architecture context should identify how critical dependencies fail and what the workload does when they do. Missing failure-mode narrative leaves availability claims ungrounded.
rules.remediationGuidance: Document primary failure modes for tier-1 dependencies in governance.PolicyConstraints or metadata.ChangeDescription, and map owning services[].Tags to those dependencies.

rules.title: Availability and recovery objectives defined by workload tier
rules.description: Tiered workloads should state availability targets plus RTO/RPO (or an explicit decision that recovery objectives are not required for this lifecycle stage).
rules.remediationGuidance: Capture RTO/RPO or availability targets per workload tier in governance.PolicyConstraints; mark non-production tiers when recovery depth is intentionally lighter.

rules.title: Redundancy proportional to criticality
rules.description: Redundancy (zonal, regional, or active-passive) should match stated criticality rather than being assumed from a cloud default.
rules.remediationGuidance: Describe redundancy strategy and justification against criticality in metadata.ChangeDescription; align services[] and relationships to the stated topology.

rules.title: Backup and restore expectations for stateful data
rules.description: Stateful stores should document backup scope, retention, and restore validation cadence appropriate to data criticality.
rules.remediationGuidance: Document backup/restore expectations for datastores[] and link retention to governance.RequiredControls.

rules.title: Graceful degradation and dependency failure behavior
rules.description: User-facing paths should describe degraded modes when non-critical dependencies fail (timeouts, fallbacks, queueing) rather than unbounded failure cascades.
rules.remediationGuidance: Record degradation/fallback behavior in governance.PolicyConstraints and tag affected services[].Tags.

rules.title: Retry, timeout, and idempotency posture for remote calls
rules.description: Distributed call paths should state timeout, retry, and idempotency expectations to avoid retry storms and inconsistent writes.
rules.remediationGuidance: Document retry/timeout/idempotency guidance for integration edges in relationships and governance.PolicyConstraints.

rules.title: Capacity during partial failure
rules.description: Design should address whether remaining capacity can absorb load when a zone/region/instance set is unavailable, or accept an explicit tradeoff.
rules.remediationGuidance: State failure-capacity assumptions or accepted risk in metadata.ChangeDescription for production-tier workloads.

rules.title: Recovery procedure ownership and test cadence
rules.description: Recovery runbooks should have named ownership and a test/exercise cadence proportionate to criticality.
rules.remediationGuidance: Capture recovery ownership and test cadence in governance.RequiredControls; note accepted exceptions for prototypes.
